address: 54 boulevard de la Tour-Maubourg, Paris, 75007, France
bio: Just a short walk from Napoleon's tomb, this restaurant takes its name from the month of the French Revolutionary calendar associated with the grape harvest. Done out in blue and orange tones, the interior exudes a chic and friendly brasserie vibe and features an impressive marble bar and silky-soft banquette seats. On the menu, innovation meets classicism, and traditional favourites are given a subtle twist (egg mayonnaise, bavette steak, tartare, crème brûlée etc) with fresh, high-quality produce. Born here in the Gros-Caillou quarter, the owner works closely with shopkeepers and friends in the neighbouring streets. The bar menu (oysters, burgers, terrine etc) is available until late. Good value for money at lunchtime....
